taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-05, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 26.6 | 4.30 | 4.30
2 | 119.1 | 2.37 | 6.67
3 | 340.4 | 0.77 | 7.44
4 | 640.3 | 0.77 | 8.21
5 | 2441.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-05, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station H-05**

Station H-05 presents a 5-layer geoelectric profile characterized by continuously increasing resistivities with depth:
- Layer 1: 26.6 Ω·m (thickness 4.30 m)
- Layer 2: 119.1 Ω·m (thickness 2.37 m, depth to base 6.67 m)
- Layer 3: 340.4 Ω·m (thickness 0.77 m, depth to base 7.44 m)
- Layer 4: 640.3 Ω·m (thickness 0.77 m, depth to base 8.21 m)
- Layer 5: 2441.4 Ω·m (resistive basement)

Because resistivities strictly increase across all successive triplets ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$), the 5-layer sequence evaluates to an AAA-type (or A-type) curve ($N-2 = 3$ letters). The archived classification of "AA-type" is incorrect for a 5-layer model as it only denotes a 4-layer sequence.

{"curve_type_stated": "AA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
